request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the colour of the leather: the orange cap, the two crossed chest straps and the loincloth become a warm mid-brown saddle leather, the brown of a chestnut, with a dark brown shadow tone; clearly brown, not orange and not red. Do not touch his skin, face or ears. Keep everything else exactly the same: the olive green skin, belt, wrist bands, dagger, eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
